notes: Which cargo test modules hold which rules of design/rules.json. Read by scripts/rules-check.py (the `unit-tests` check): it runs these modules (`cargo test --lib --features testing -- <module>:: ...`), and a rule is `passing` through them only when every test of its modules passed. `module` is the test path from the crate root (a file of src/, or a module inside it); `rules` are the rule IDs the module's tests hold; `covers` says in one line which part of the rule they hold, so a rule is never read as more covered than it is. A module that has no test fails the run (the map is stale). Tests of the checkers themselves (inspector/checks/tests.rs shows a known-bad and a clean fixture for each layout rule) hold IN-05 only, not the rules they look for. Derived from the doc comment and the test names of each module and from the `enforced_by` text of rules.json; hand-written, reviewed by `python3 scripts/rules-check.py --registry`.
